data.title: TEAMSTERS ORGANIZE TWO DHL SUBCONTRACTORS IN 24 HOURS
data.description: In Carrollton, Texas, on September 18, 2026, a significant development occurred as fifty-five drivers working with Cartage Services by DeliverOL and Driven-Force Inc., who are subcontractors for DHL Express, made a unanimous decision to join Local 745. This move indicates a strong show of unity and support among the drivers. They are now gearing up to initiate negotiations for their first contracts. This decision marks a notable milestone in the labor sector and signifies the drivers' commitment to securing their rights and interests.

data.title: Largest Kidney Patient Group Applauds HHS Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr.'s Appointments to the U.S. Preventive Services Task Force
data.description: On September 18, 2026, the American Association of Kidney Patients (AAKP), the country's foremost independent and nonpartisan organization advocating for kidney patients, released statements from its patient leaders in reaction to Health and Human Services. The AAKP, established in 1969, represents over 30 million Americans affected by kidney diseases and strives to improve quality of life for patients through education, advocacy, and support. The organization's leadership voiced concerns and suggestions on healthcare policy decisions affecting kidney patients, emphasizing the need for patient-centered care and improved access to treatments and resources.

data.title: Duke Energy asks Carolinas customers to reduce electricity use during today's peak-demand period
data.description: Today, on September 18, 2026, Charlotte, North Carolina is experiencing abnormally hot weather, leading to a surge in electricity consumption in the Carolinas. Duke Energy has issued a request to customers in North Carolina and South Carolina to actively decrease their electricity usage between 2 to 8 p.m. in order to alleviate strain on the power grid. This voluntary reduction in electricity consumption is crucial to maintain smooth operations during this period of heightened demand.
